changelog.title: SteamLite 9.0.2 - Settings fix
items: Fixed: clicking a tab in Settings pushed the top bar half off the screen

news.title: SteamLite 10.0.0 comes January 2027
news.content: SteamLite 10.0.0 comes January 2027 with brand new features and [REDACTED]

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.2 Released - Settings fix
news.content: An emergency fix for 9.0.1: clicking a tab in Settings could push the top bar half off the screen. It is fixed in 9.0.2.

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.1 Released - New achievements and themes
news.content: SteamLite 9.0.1 is out. A tidier header with the extras in one folder, a floating now-playing pill you can move anywhere, 15 new achievements, 3 new themes (Royal Gold, Mocha Cream, Sakura Night), icons instead of emojis and a redesigned news widget. A level now takes 80,000 XP; your current level is unchanged.

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 Released - Glass, Couch mode and more
news.content: SteamLite 9.0.0 is here. A new floating glass interface (Classic is one switch away), a full-page Settings, couch mode for your sofa with a page for every game, Spotify now playing in the top bar, a much better Discord presence card and a redesigned Tools & extras. It uses less memory and no idle CPU, and the Updater can now switch between Stable and Beta.

news.title: SteamLite 8.7.4 Released - Setup Fix
news.content: SteamLite 8.7.4 fixes the restart prompt that appeared at the end of setup in 8.7.3, and adds a Stable / Beta switch to the SteamLite Updater.

news.title: SteamLite 8.7.3 Released - Updater Fix
news.content: SteamLite 8.7.3 fixes the SteamLite Updater not being replaced when it ran the update itself. After this version the Updater always matches your SteamLite, including the new beta location.
